items.title: Material Receipt Note (GRN)
items.context: Material Management › Goods Receipt and Quality Inspection › Material Receipt Note (GRN)

cards.title: When do stores staff prepare a receipt after a consignment arrives, and what do they confirm it against?
cards.body:
Stores staff prepare a **goods receipt** when a vehicle or consignment has arrived at the company.
They confirm what was received against the **purchase order**, gate entry, stock transfer or challan.

cards.title: What does an authorized goods receipt give stores, the purchase team and finance once it is complete?
cards.body:
An **authorized** receipt raises stock, closes orders against what arrived, and gives finance a valued entry.
Stock rises only for checked receipts, and orders, indents and transfers close against actual receipts.
Finance uses the **valued inward entry** for the **purchase bill**.

cards.title: Where does the goods receipt sit between the gate entry and the quality inspection of received goods?
cards.body:
The goods receipt comes after the **gate entry** and before the inspection documents.
The gate records the inward vehicle, stores receive the goods, then an **inspection intimation** and an **inspection entry** follow.

cards.title: Which purchasing steps come before stores receive goods in the Procure-to-Pay flow, and which is last?
cards.body:
Receiving the goods is the last step of the **Procure-to-Pay** flow.
A request becomes a **purchase request**, the buyer compares quotations and places the **purchase order**, then the gate and stores receive it.

cards.title: What is the difference between the challan quantity and the received quantity on a goods receipt line?
cards.body:
**Challan quantity** is what the supplier's challan declares; **received quantity** is what stores record as received.
Both are needed on every line: the challan quantity must be above zero and the received quantity must be entered.
source_refs: Material Receipt Note (GRN): Line Quantities Present [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:79879] (rule:material-receipt-note-line-quantities-present)

cards.title: What is free-of-cost (FOC) quantity on a goods receipt line, and what is the most stores can record?
cards.body:
**FOC quantity** is the free quantity received on a line, recorded apart from the accepted quantity.
It can never be more than the **received quantity**, and it carries its own rate, amount and warehouse.
source_refs: Detail rows are replaced on save [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:78616] (rule:detail-replacement-on-save)

cards.title: What is replaceable quantity on a goods receipt, and why does a line need rejected quantity first?
cards.body:
**Replaceable quantity** can be recorded on a line only when that line has **rejected quantity**.
Marking it fills in the rejected quantity, and it must be above zero and not more than the received quantity.
source_refs: Detail rows are replaced on save [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:78616] (rule:detail-replacement-on-save)

cards.title: What changes on a receipt when stores staff choose the MRA document type instead of the GRN type?
cards.body:
A receipt is either a **GRN** or an **MRA**, and choosing MRA changes the defaults.
With MRA the source defaults to **Purchase Order**, excise is switched off, locations unlock, consignee details open, and header and item taxes are saved.

cards.title: What does marking a goods receipt as Inspection Required mean, and when is it forced on?
cards.body:
**Inspection Required** means the receipt must pass quality inspection before it can be authorized.
If the company forces **receipt inspection**, the flag is set and locked, so stores staff cannot switch it off.

cards.title: What must each lot row carry when stores staff receive a heat-wise item on a goods receipt?
cards.body:
A **heat-wise item** is received in lot rows, each with a heat number or serial number.
Each lot row also needs a **warehouse** and an **accepted quantity**, and lot totals must match the line's challan and received quantities.

cards.title: What happens to the warehouse on a receipt line when stores staff choose a BIN card for the item?
cards.body:
A **BIN card** is a storage bin inside a warehouse, and choosing one fills and locks the line's **warehouse**.
Under a company setting, an item that uses bins but has no BIN card gives a warning or an error, unless inspection is already done.

cards.title: Which received items need a batch number and which need an expiry date on the goods receipt?
cards.body:
Items kept by batch need a **batch number**, and items with an expiry need an **expiry date**.
For serial items with expiry, each serial number carries its own expiry date.
source_refs: Material Receipt Note (GRN): Batch and Expiry [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:79861] (rule:material-receipt-note-batch-and-expiry)
Document numbers are generated and must be unique [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:78732] (rule:document-numbering)

cards.title: How does a goods receipt link the purchase order unit to the stock unit through conversion factors?
cards.body:
Two **conversion factors** link the **order unit** to the **stock unit** on each line.
Both factors must be above zero, and stores staff can change them only for the item conversion type that allows editing.

cards.title: When does a goods receipt need no purchase bill at all, even after it is saved?
cards.body:
No **purchase bill** is needed when **accepted quantity** is zero and there is no return through dispatch challan.
The system works this out again on every save, so the flag follows the latest quantities.
source_refs: Mandatory fields and valid selections on documents [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:79742] (rule:mandatory-document-fields)

cards.title: Why can stores staff not put capital and non-capital items on the same goods receipt?
cards.body:
One receipt holds either **capital items** or **non-capital items**, never both.
The receipt also needs at least one selected line, and the same item with the same make cannot appear twice.

cards.title: How many dispatch challans can one goods receipt cover when material comes from another unit of the company?
cards.body:
An **inter-unit receipt** is made against one **dispatch challan** only.
When the reference is inter-unit, stores staff must choose that dispatch challan before the receipt can be saved.
source_refs: Material Receipt Note (GRN): Inter-unit Dispatch Challan [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:79877] (rule:material-receipt-note-inter-unit-dispatch-challan)
Material Receipt Note (GRN): Reference Selection Consistency [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:79887] (rule:material-receipt-note-reference-selection-consistency)

cards.title: Why can stores staff not save a goods receipt again once it has been authorized, and how is it blocked?
cards.body:
An **authorized** receipt cannot be saved again, because stock is posted at authorization.
The screen refuses a receipt loaded as Authorized, and the system also refuses any receipt that already has an **authorizer** recorded.
A wrong authorized receipt is corrected by deleting it while its stock is unused, not by editing it.
source_refs: Authorized or in-use records are locked [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:77939] (rule:authorized-document-lock)
Deleting a document is restricted and reverses its links [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:82387] (rule:transaction-delete-rules)
Material Receipt Note (GRN): Stock Posting on Authorization [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:79893] (rule:material-receipt-note-stock-posting-on-authorization)

cards.title: What does each goods receipt status record about who released and who authorized the receipt, and when?
cards.body:
A receipt moves Initial -> Release -> Authorized, and each status records more of its history.
- **Initial** records neither a releaser nor an authorizer.
- **Release** records the person who released it and the date.
- **Authorized** records the person who saved it as authorizer, with the date.
source_refs: Material Receipt Note (GRN): Status Mapping and Audit [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:79892] (rule:material-receipt-note-status-mapping-and-audit)

cards.title: Under multi-level approval of a goods receipt, who can set it to Authorized and how does that happen?
cards.body:
Under **multi-level approval**, only the **last-level approver** can authorize a receipt.
When the last-level approver records the approval, the system moves the status from Release to Authorized.
Anyone setting Authorized directly, or before the last level approves, is refused.

cards.title: Why is a receipt line refused when accepted, rejected and free quantity do not add up to received quantity?
cards.body:
For order and gate entry receipts, **accepted, rejected and free** must add up to the **received quantity**.
If the company validates on the challan, the three must equal the **challan quantity** instead.
Stores staff correct the split before saving; the line is refused until it balances.

cards.title: Why can stores staff not use a gate entry for a second goods receipt once one receipt is made from it?
cards.body:
A **gate entry** can feed only one goods receipt; a second receipt from it is refused.
The receipt writes its **received quantity** back to the gate entry, unless weighment controls that quantity.
A gate entry with a receipt against it also cannot be deleted.
source_refs: Material Receipt Note (GRN): Gate Entry Single Use [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:79873] (rule:material-receipt-note-gate-entry-single-use)
Deleting a document is restricted and reverses its links [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:82387] (rule:transaction-delete-rules)

cards.title: What must the inspecting department finish before a goods receipt that needs inspection can be authorized?
cards.body:
A receipt marked **Inspection Required** cannot be authorized until both inspection documents exist.
- An **inspection intimation** lists the receipt lines for the inspecting department.
- The inspecting department records accepted and rejected quantity in an **inspection entry**.
- Only then can the receipt be authorized; either one missing blocks it.

cards.title: Why did stock not rise when stores staff saved the goods receipt, and when does it rise?
cards.body:
Saving adds no stock; stock rises only when the receipt is **Authorized**.
The company increases stock only for checked and authorized receipts, so **Initial** and **Release** post nothing.
Authorization posts stock only if inspection, weighment and the **stock month** checks pass.
source_refs: Material Receipt Note (GRN): Stock Posting on Authorization [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:79893] (rule:material-receipt-note-stock-posting-on-authorization)

cards.title: Why is a goods receipt refused when its order or gate entry is dated later or uses a different currency?
cards.body:
A receipt cannot reference a document dated after the **receipt date** or in a different **currency**.
Every receipt except Direct needs at least one selected reference, and each one is checked against the receipt's date and currency.
Stores staff change the receipt date or choose a matching reference.
source_refs: Mandatory fields and valid selections on documents [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:79742] (rule:mandatory-document-fields)

cards.title: What extra details must stores staff enter when they make a Direct goods receipt without any order?
cards.body:
A **Direct receipt** has no reference, so stores staff enter more details by hand.
**Department** and **freight type** are required, and with freight type TOPAY the **transporter** is required too.
Only Direct receipts let stores staff add lines and enter item, make, grade, specification and rate.

cards.title: Why must the vendor bill, challan, LR and e-way bill dates on a receipt never be later than the receipt date?
cards.body:
Each supporting document number needs its date, and that date cannot be after the **receipt date**.
This applies to the **vendor bill**, the challan, the LR and the **e-way bill**.
Vendor bill number and bill date must be given together or both left empty.

cards.title: How many serial numbers must stores staff record for a serial item on a goods receipt line?
cards.body:
A serial item needs one **serial number** for every unit of **accepted plus rejected** quantity.
Serial numbers cannot repeat, and items with an expiry need an **expiry date** for each serial.
For example, 48 accepted and 2 rejected need exactly 50 serial numbers.
source_refs: Document numbers are generated and must be unique [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:78732] (rule:document-numbering)

cards.title: Which earlier documents does saving a goods receipt update, and what happens when the receipt is edited?
cards.body:
Saving a receipt recalculates the status of the documents it was made from.
These are the **purchase order** line, gate pass, service order, **purchase request**, sales order and stock transfer.
Editing a receipt first resets those statuses, then the save works them out again.
source_refs: Material Receipt Note (GRN): Source Status Cascade [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:79891] (rule:material-receipt-note-source-status-cascade)

cards.title: When can stores staff mark rejected goods for return through a dispatch challan, and what does it change?
cards.body:
**Return through dispatch challan** opens only once a selected line has **rejected quantity**.
When it is marked, the rejected quantity is included in the **finance posting** quantity.
Under a company setting, authorizing an inspected receipt with rejection but without it gives a warning or an error.
source_refs: Material Receipt Note (GRN): Return through Dispatch Challan [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:79889] (rule:material-receipt-note-return-through-dispatch-challan)
Material Receipt Note (GRN): Configurable Custom Validations [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:79864] (rule:material-receipt-note-configurable-custom-validations)

cards.title: Why is a goods receipt refused on save when another user changed it after it was opened?
cards.body:
A receipt changed by another user since it was opened is refused on save, and must be **reloaded**.
The header and all lines are saved in **one transaction**, so a refused save changes nothing.
Stores staff reload the receipt and then make their change again.
source_refs: Header and details are saved in one transaction [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:77918] (rule:atomic-save)

cards.title: Why must all orders or gate entries chosen on one goods receipt share the same source and currency?
cards.body:
All references on one receipt must share the same **source** and **currency**.
Orders, or gate entries, in different currencies cannot be combined on one receipt.
A different **exchange rate** only gives a warning, and stores staff may continue.
source_refs: Material Receipt Note (GRN): Reference Selection Consistency [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:79887] (rule:material-receipt-note-reference-selection-consistency)

cards.title: In what order do stores staff build a goods receipt against open orders or gate entries for a supplier?
cards.body:
Stores staff choose the source first, because it decides which references are listed.
- Choose the document type and **source document**.
- Choose the vendor and **vendor location**; open references for that location are listed.
- Select references, then enter challan, received, accepted and rejected quantities.
source_refs: Mandatory fields and valid selections on documents [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:79742] (rule:mandatory-document-fields)

cards.title: Is a fourth delivery of 400 kg allowed on a 5,000 kg order with 3% tolerance after 4,800 kg received?
cards.body:
Only with a warning: 5,200 kg passes the 5,150 kg limit, and the excess over the order is 200 kg.
Deliveries against one order are added up, and the total may not pass the order quantity plus its **tolerance**.
- Earlier receipts total 4,800 kg; this delivery makes 5,200 kg.
- The limit is 5,000 plus 3%, which is 5,150 kg.
- By default the system shows a **warning** and stores staff may continue.
- If the company sets this check as an **error**, the save is refused.
Under the error setting, receive at most 350 kg on this receipt.

cards.title: What happens to stock, vouchers and order status when stores staff delete an authorized goods receipt?
cards.body:
An **authorized** receipt can be deleted while its stock is unused, and deletion reverses everything it posted.
Stores staff confirm the delete, and the system checks the stock before removing anything.
- Refused if material was **issued** from the receipt's lots.
- Refused if a tyre repair entry exists or the **stock month** is locked.
- Otherwise lots, the finance voucher and excise posting are removed.
- Order, request and transfer statuses are restored.
If the refusal names an issue number, that issue is using the stock.
source_refs: Deleting a document is restricted and reverses its links [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:82387] (rule:transaction-delete-rules)
Authorized or in-use records are locked [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:77939] (rule:authorized-document-lock)

cards.title: A goods receipt is refused when stores staff set it to Authorized: what should they check, and in what order?
cards.body:
Check inspection, approval, the stock month and quantities, in that order.
Stores staff run these checks before trying again.
- Is the **inspection intimation** and **inspection entry** done?
- Under multi-level approval, has the **last level** approved?
- Is the stock month locked by monthly closing?
- Is rejected quantity above inspection's rejected quantity, or weighment missing?
If all pass, reload the receipt in case another user changed it.
source_refs: Material Receipt Note (GRN): Stock Posting on Authorization [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:79893] (rule:material-receipt-note-stock-posting-on-authorization)
Header and details are saved in one transaction [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:77918] (rule:atomic-save)

cards.title: A 1,000-unit delivery has 40 units rejected at inspection: what do stock, rejection and the return record?
cards.body:
Stock rises by 960 units at authorization, and the 40 rejected units stay out of stock.
Stores staff receive the goods, the inspecting department inspects, and authorization posts only the **accepted quantity**.
- Stores staff record challan 1,000 and received 1,000, and save as **Release**.
- Inspection records 40 rejected, so accepted is 960.
- The receipt's rejected quantity cannot exceed inspection's 40.
- With **return through dispatch challan** marked, authorization adds 960 to stock.
Entering 45 rejected on the receipt is refused; match the inspection figure.
source_refs: Material Receipt Note (GRN): Stock Posting on Authorization [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:79893] (rule:material-receipt-note-stock-posting-on-authorization)
Material Receipt Note (GRN): Return through Dispatch Challan [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:79889] (rule:material-receipt-note-return-through-dispatch-challan)

cards.title: Why can stores staff neither authorize nor delete an October receipt once October stock is closed?
cards.body:
A locked **stock month** blocks both authorization and deletion of receipts in that month.
Monthly closing locks the month's stock, so receipts dated in it can no longer post or reverse stock.
- A receipt dated 28 October is still in Release on 3 November.
- October is locked by **stock monthly closing**.
- Authorizing it is refused; deleting an authorized October receipt is refused too.
- The receipt stays in Release, so October stock is unchanged.
source_refs: Material Receipt Note (GRN): Stock Posting on Authorization [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:79893] (rule:material-receipt-note-stock-posting-on-authorization)
Deleting a document is restricted and reverses its links [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:82387] (rule:transaction-delete-rules)

cards.title: How is the rate of a raw material line recalculated at authorization when challan quantity is passed on?
cards.body:
When the company passes on **challan quantity**, the raw material rate is recalculated at authorization.
The rate becomes challan quantity times rate, divided by **accepted quantity**.
- Challan 10,000 kg at 50 per kg is worth 500,000.
- Accepted is 9,800 kg.
- New rate = 500,000 / 9,800 = 51.02 per kg.
- With return through dispatch challan, divide by accepted plus rejected instead.
This applies only to raw material items under that company setting.

cards.title: How is the line rate worked out when a multi-rate item arrives as 600 units at one rate and 400 at another?
cards.body:
The line rate becomes the **weighted average** of the attribute rates, here 98 per unit.
For a **multi-rate item**, stores staff split the accepted quantity by attribute, and each attribute rate is the order rate plus its difference.
- Order rate 100; attribute A has difference 0, attribute B has minus 5.
- A: 600 x 100 = 60,000. B: 400 x 95 = 38,000.
- Total 98,000 / 1,000 = 98 per unit.
If attribute quantities total less than accepted quantity, the save is refused.

cards.title: An expected order or gate entry does not appear when stores staff build a receipt: what should they check?
cards.body:
Only **open references** for the chosen source and vendor location are offered.
Stores staff check these in order.
- Is the right **source document** chosen for the document type?
- Is the right **vendor location** chosen, not another location?
- Is the gate entry already used by another receipt?
- Is the reference dated after the receipt date?
source_refs: Material Receipt Note (GRN): Gate Entry Single Use [4:478dbad0-cd96-4aa4-bac7-6d61036ab7b0:79873] (rule:material-receipt-note-gate-entry-single-use)
